messages:
ana: Quick copy review for the small banner that shows when we fall back to a lower-cost model. Want it short, non-alarming, and clear about next steps. Also need copy for the dismiss option and the tiny preference dropdown. Drafts below.

ana: Draft 1 (bare):
`Fallback model in use. Results may vary slightly. Details · Dismiss`

kevin: Short and OK, but "may vary slightly" feels vague. What does "Dismiss" do? Permanently hide? session-only? we should clarify.

riley: Agree. Also we should include microcopy for the three-dot menu option: `Hide for 24 hours` vs `Don't show again`. Those have different permanence.

mina: UX suggestion: prefer time-bounded hide instead of absolute "Don't show again" to avoid users accidentally silencing important notices. So propose `Hide for 24 hours` and `Show details`.

ana: Good point. New banner attempt:
`Fallback active. An alternate model is serving responses; you may notice small output or latency differences. Details · Hide for 24 hours`

kevin: wording nit: "small output or latency differences" is clunky. Maybe "minor output or latency differences." Also add an aria-label for the hide control: "Hide banner for 24 hours".

riley: For the details panel copy: header should be friendly: `Why we switched models` not too formal. Inside include: reason (capacity/policy), when it started, whether it's temporary, and what to do if you need original model.

mina: If user picks `Hide for 24 hours`, we need microcopy for the confirmation toast: `Banner hidden for 24 hours. You can re-enable it in Settings > Notifications.` Keep toast sentence short.

ana: Draft toast copy: `Banner hidden for 24 hours — it can be re-enabled in Settings.`

kevin: Localization note: avoid em-dashes and long sentences. Keep a plain sentence for translators. Eg: `Banner hidden for 24 hours. Re-enable in Settings.`

riley: Accessibility: make the hide action keyboard reachable and announce the toast. For screen readers the toast text should be short and focusable for a few seconds. Also ensure the details link has aria-expanded when panel opens.

mina: QA note: add a telemetry flag name for the hide action: `ui.fallback.hide_duration=24h` so analytics can surface how often people hide banners.

ana: Another microcopy question: if we offer `Request again` in details, microcopy should warn about cost: propose `Request again (this will resend your input and may incur additional cost)`. Long, but explicit. Maybe shorter: `Request again — may incur extra cost`

kevin: prefer parentheses for clarity: `Request again (may incur extra cost)`. Keep CTA label short in the button but show full explanation in tooltip. Button text: `Request again`. Tooltip: `Resends your request to the primary model and may incur additional cost.`

riley: Also suggest a soft-confirm for large inputs: when input > 50k tokens show `Confirm resend (resending may be billed)` modal.

mina: I18N: create translation keys for each string. Example keys: `fallback.banner.text`, `fallback.banner.hide24`, `fallback.toast.hidden24`, `fallback.details.header`, `fallback.request.button`, `fallback.request.tooltip`. Add fallback english string for each key.

ana: Finalized strings for design docs:
- banner: `Fallback active. An alternate model is serving responses. You may notice minor output or latency differences. Details · Hide for 24 hours`
- details header: `Why we switched models`
- request button label: `Request again`
- request tooltip: `Resends your request to the primary model and may incur additional cost.`
- hide toast: `Banner hidden for 24 hours. Re-enable in Settings.`

kevin: LGTM. Add accessibility checklist to the ticket: role=status, keyboard focus on hide action, aria-expanded on details, toast announced, contrast checks for the hide affordance.

riley: QA-bot: scheduling note: remember to include unit tests for the hide duration, the toast message, and the telemetry flag.

ana: thanks all. I'll update Figma and add the translation key table in the PR description. Will also add the confirm flow for large inputs as a separate follow-up.
